description.value: The BnB on Bowen Island is a self-contained apartment-style accommodation on Bowen Island, a small ferry-accessible island off the coast of West Vancouver. For touring cyclists completing the Howe Sound circuit or island-hopping routes, Bowen Island serves as a compact overnight destination reachable via BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay. No further details about the property's size, style, or facilities could be confirmed.
